Commentary.Commentary: West Indies will be disappointed with their efforts after opting to bat first. They had a poor start but a good knock by Blackwood in the middle kept them in the hunt. Soon after his dismissal, Samuels too departed. The lower middle order was toothless to the spinning balls. A total of close to 200 was possible because of Cummins and Gabriels' counter-attack. The Indian batting will begin in a while and it will be interesting to see how they go about the total. Do join us for the final session of day 1 in a bit.

Talking about the Indian bowling, it was Shami who nicely set up the batsmen with his good line and length. The real star was Ashwin who took another 5-fer by cleaning up the West Indies' tail in no time. The Indians had to wait for some more time until Mishra picked up the last wicket as Cummins and Gabriel stitched a partnership of 38 runs.

That ends the 1st innings of West Indies with a total close to 200 on the board and it will be TEA. After taking 4 wickets in the first session, India did exceptionally well to bowl out the hosts just inside the 2nd session. Samuels did show some resistance but was undone by Ashwin just after lunch.

OUT! Caught! That ends the innings. Landed outside off, Gabriel looks to play the slog but gets a top edge which goes high in the air. Virat Kohli calls for it from extra cover and takes it near mid off. WEST INDIES HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 196.
DROPPED! A tough chance. Short and outside off, Gabriel looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge to first slip. Ajinkya Rahane reacts well but is unable to hold on. That came on pretty quickly.
Down the leg side, padded away.
Full on middle, Cummins hammers this straight back. Yadav puts his right leg in the way and deflects it towards extra cover.
A bouncer way down the leg side, MC ducks and Saha dives to his right to stop the ball.
SIX! Thrash! A length ball on middle, Cummins swats this over mid-wicket!
Yadav comes around the wicket...

FOUR! Not quite sweetly timed but he will get a boundary. A length ball outside off, Cummins backs away and looks to hammer it away. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat past mid off and reaches the fence, beating Cheteshwar Pujara's desperate dive at the ropes. The stand moves to 32 from 35 balls. Moves to 20 from 23.
That is a nasty one, dug in short around leg, Miguel looks to fend it away but the ball goes off the arm to point.
A bouncer on middle, Cummins ducks.
UMESH YADAV to bowl now.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Make that an action replay of the previous delivery. He is going after everything.
Throws it up again outside off, Shannon has another swing but misses this time.
SIX! Take that! Raw power. Floated outside off, Gabriel launches into this one and slogs this miles over long on! Moves to 15 from 17 balls.
NO BALL. Oversteps and bowls it on middle, pushed through covers for a single.
Flatter down the leg side, Miguel looks to sweep but fails to make contact.
The googly around off, Cummins pushes but misses.
FOUR! Too short outside off, Gabriel rocks back and cuts it through the covers for a boundary! The stand moves to 20 from 25 balls.
Long hop outside off, slapped towards mid off.
This time Gabriel goes for a big hoick but misses.
Around off, a tad short, defended from the crease.
Throws this one up again, Miguel goes hard with the slog and the ball goes off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket. A single taken.
SIX! Spanked! Full on middle, Cummins gets underneath it and slog sweeps it massively over mid-wicket! The stand moves to 15 from 20 balls with Cummins on 12.
Outside off, defended back to the bowler.

RUN OUT CHANCE! MISSED! Full on middle, Shannon looks to heave and the ball goes of the inside edge towards square leg. Cummins wants the single but is sent back. He is halfway down the track and is gone for all money. Ravichandran Ashwion gets to the ball and throws it to the bowler who fumbles. Mishra complains to Ashwin that the throw could have been better.
Tossed up outside off, Gabriel goes for the massive slog sweep but misses.
Outside off, left alone.
Outside off, driven straight to short cover.

Another LBW appeal, turned down. The wrong 'un from Mishra, outside off, Gabriel stays back to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Umpire Ian Gould keeps his hand in the pocket. Hawk Eye shows it to be hitting leg stump.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

EXCELLENT EFFORT! Gabriel swings this towards long on. Cheteshwar Pujara at long on, leaps, takes the catch but realizes that he is going beyond the boundary. Hence, throws the ball away. A single taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Thrown up outside off, Gabriel hammers it through mid on and gets s boundary!
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, the batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.

FOUR! Smoked! Full and around off, Cummins gets underneath it and slogs it over long on. There is a fielder stationed at the boundary but he is just a bit inside and the ball goes over him and lands just inside the boundary.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.
Third play and a miss in a row.
Another googly outside off, Miguel pushes but misses again.
The googly outside off, Cummins pushes hard but misses.
Landed outside off, defended off the back foot.

OUT! 18th 5-wicket haul in Tests for Ashwin! Boy, that is a ratio of a fifer in almost every three innings. Brilliant bowling again. Tosses this one outside off, Holder steps out of his crease and looks to defend. The ball takes the inside edge, pops onto the pads, then lobs up. Lokesh Rahul from short leg goes back and Shikhar Dhawan gets around from shot fine leg. Rahul calls for it and takes it behind his head. Full and outside off, well blocked out.
Landed outside off, well defended.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Not quite well hit though. Mishra bowls a googly, from outside off, Holder has a swipe and gets it from the inner half of the bat through square leg and gets a boundary. Moves to 13 at run-a-ball.
Full and outside off, driven towards short extra cover.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
Outside off, Miguel pushes it through extra cover and gets his first run in Test cricket.
On middle, Cummins flicks it uppishly which goes just short and wide of Cheteshwar Pujara at short leg.
Full and outside off, Holder drives it to long off for a single.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, Cummins misses his flick.

OUT! Caught! Ashwin has his fourth. Full on middle, Bishoo looks to play the slog sweep. That seems pretty ill-advised when you have a fielder at the mid-wicket boundary and it turns out so. Only, the ball does not carry to that fielder. It does take the top edge though, goes straight up in the air and Shikhar Dhawan at short fine leg takes a simple one. Can the Windies hang around till Tea?
Outside off, well blocked out again.
Full and outside off, well defended.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Tossed up again, well defended.
Nicely floated but this is down the leg side, Bishoo misses his flick.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

EDGED! THROUGH! Full and outside off, Bishoo pushes at it and gets a thick outside edge which does not carry to Rahane at first slip. Lack of bounce makes the ball go through as well. Two runs taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Takes this on the full and sweeps it through square leg for a couple. The outfield has slowed down a bit. Ishant Sharma gets to the ball from square leg and the batsmen take a couple.
Oooh...nearly! Landed outside off, Bishoo looks to poke at it but gets a thick inside edge which nearly rolls back onto the stumps!
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, Bishoo drives it through the covers. Amit Mishra gives it a good chase from mid off, gets to the stopping ball, turns around and throws, slipping as well. Three runs taken.
Outside off, another play and a miss.
Full and around off, Devendra pushes it through the covers and gets a couple. The stand moves to 11 from 23 balls.
Landed around off, Bishoo has a poke and misses again.
NO BALL. Oversteps and bowls a bouncer, Bishoo ducks.
Back to the Shami-Bishoo contest...
A length ball around middle, Holder tucks it uppishly towards mid-wicket for a single.
Very full on middle, pushed away defensively.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full again, around leg, swept straight to square leg.
Full on middle, Bishoo defends with a lunge.

Poor running. Landed outside off, Holder leans and lofts it over covers. There is easily two on offer by the time long off gets around but Bishoo clearly has preferences on the bowler he wants to face. Takes just the single.
Around off, Holder goes back and works it towards short leg.
Goes fuller, around off, Devendra has a hack but toe ends it to mid on.

ANOTHER APPEAL! TURNED DOWN AGAIN! Well, this time the whole Indian team is shocked. Similar ball to the previous one. This one is around off and comes back further in, Bishoo hangs back to defend but misses. Umpire Ian Gould shakes his head again and replays confirm a noise as the ball passes his bat. Lucky.

Huge appeal for a caught behind! Turned down! Shami is not happy. Back of a length outside off, angled in, Bishoo looks to defend, playing inside the line and misses. Saha and Shami appeal but umpire Gould keeps his hand in his pocket. Replays are inconclusive.
This is around off, Bishoo defends it properly towards covers.
On a good length outside off, Bishoo flirts with the line and is beaten.
Drinks are on the field... West Indies are losing wickets at regular intervals. They lost another 3 wickets in this period. The hosts need to put up some fight against the visiting side.

Beaten! Floater ball, Holder goes for an elusive drive but gets beaten. The appeal is made for a caught behind, Ashwin and Saha go up for it in the action. Ashwin was convinced but Saha was not that sure. Dar says not out and states that the bat hit the ground.
FOUR! Driven! Tossed up ball outside off, Holder strides forward and drives it through covers for a well placed boundary.
Loopy ball on off, played to the off side for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, defended of the front foot.
Similar ball on off, Bishoo drives it and the ball hits the silly point fielder.
Tossed up ball on off, Bishoo stays tall and plays it to the off side.
Length ball on off, played to mid off for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
DEVENDRA BISHOO will bat next.

OUT! That is a fine catch! Shami has his second wicket. Full and outside off, a touch wide, Chase looks to drive away from his body and gets a thick outside edge. The ball dies on its way to the slip cordon but Shikhar Dhawan at first slip watches the ball to the ball carefully and takes it calmly to his left. West Indies could get bowled out in this session.
A short ball down the leg side, RC gets across and lets it through.
There comes the outside edge, off a fuller ball, Roston looks to drive but gets an outside edge which lands short of Rahane at second slip.

That is nicely played. A length ball outside off, Chase comes forward and nicely opens the face of the bat to steer it through gully to third man. Cheteshwar Pujara chases it down and the batsmen want the third run but settle for two.
Serves it on middle, played to mid on for a single.
Serves a full ball on off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Tossed up ball on middle, played to mid-wicket.
Driven towards the mid on region. One run added to the total.

OUT! Ashwin strikes again! Tossed up ball outside off, Dowrick gets back and looks to leave that ball. He was late in removing his bat as the bat gets stuck in his back pad. The ball kisses the willow and Saha behind the stumps takes a good catch. west Indies 6 down now.

Hurls a similar ball outside off, Chase gets forward and leaves it for the keeper.

Shami is bending his back nicely. Length ball outside off, moving away. Left alone.

Length ball outside off, Chase sees it early and leaves it for the keeper.
SHAMI back on.
Tossed up ball on off, played to mid off.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Arm ball on middle, Dowrick plays it to the leg side.

Serves it on middle and leg, played to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Chase defends it to the off side.
Some runs! Fuller ball on off, Dowrich pushes it tamely through vacant mid off for a brace.
Back to basics! Serves a length ball outside off, fifth stump line. Dowrich leaves it yet again.
Full ball on middle and leg, Shane gets to use his bat and he pushes that to short mid-wicket.
Similar ball outside off, Shane is not bothered.
Tad fuller ball outside off, Dowrich sees it early and drops his bat to let it through.
Hurls a length ball outside off, it held its line. Dowrich leaves it for the keeper.
Starts with a no ball! Full ball outside off, Dowrich sets back and pushes it through covers for a brace. Ishant needs to mark up his run-up again maybe.
Driven through mid-on by the batsman.
Loopy ball outside off, pushed to the off side for a single.
Beaten! Tossed up ball outside off, it angles in after pitching. Dowrich prods but gets beaten.
On middle and leg, Dowrich plays it gently to short mid-wicket.

Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A good length ball on off, played to covers.
FOUR! Edged and boundary! Length ball on off, angles in, Chase hangs in his bat and the ball takes an outside edge. It goes through the gap between second slip and gully to fence.
No ball! Full ball on off, Chase strides forward and blocks it. Another no ball for overstepping.
Hurls a perfect length ball wide outside off Chase leaves that.
Length ball outside off, Chase leaves it for the keeper.
Length ball on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
A loopy ball outside off, Dowrich lets it through.
Serves it full on off, defended watchfully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

OUT! Ashwin strikes! Flighted ball on middle and leg, Samuels shimmies a bit and tries to flick it through the leg side. The ball turned a bit more and it goes off the inner half of the bat via pads to short leg. KL Rahul stationed there takes it with glee. The dangerman has to go and West Indies are 5 down now.
West Indies do not have a deep batting line-up, they will need to be a bit careful here.
SIX! Nicely played. Tossed up outside off, Samuels comes down the track and lofts it over long on for a biggie.
Landed outside off, Samuels defends it from his crease.
On the pads, played to the leg side for a single.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
No ball! Full ball on off, defended off the front foot. A no ball for overstepping yet again.
A perfect length ball on off, Samuels hangs his bat and gets an outside edge to first slip on one bounce.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries! Length ball outside off, Samuels sets back and cuts it through point for another boundary. Marlon is finding boundaries easily.
FOUR! Edged and runs! Hurls a short ball outside off, Marlon looks to cut it hard but it goes off the outside edge through gully for a boundary.
FOUR! Samuels on the move now! Full ball on off, Samuels lofts it cleanly over covers for a boundary.
Serves a full ball outside off, it is punched off the back foot to covers.
Tossed up on off, a play and a miss by the batsman.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Serves a loopy ball on off, pushed through covers for a brace.
Loopy ball on off and it is turned down the leg side.
ASHWIN will continue to bowl.
Tossed up ball on off, defended of the front foot.
Ishant angles in a length ball form wide outside the crease. Samuels shoulders his arms.
Short and wide outside off, Samuels is bored to let that through so he decides to cut it hard but misses.
As expected, the shower has passed away. The players are back out in the middle. Ishant Sharma to finish his pending over...
With that boundary, the drizzle has started to come down a bit harder. The umpires make a move now, calling for the covers. Does not look like a big delay. Might be a passing shower.
NO BALL! FOUR! Smoked! A short ball outside off, Ishant oversteps as well and Samuels pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Outside off, watchfully defended.
It has started to drizzle. But no movement from the umpires yet.
Full and down the leg side, Samuels lets it go.
Much better, full and just around off, Samuels manages to dig it out to the bowler.
Landed outside off, a touch wide to start, left alone.

Welcome back for the second session. First things first, the skies have cleared up nicely and it no longer raining, neither is it overcast. But it not entirely sunny either. Out come the players on the field. Kohli has turned to Ishant Sharma after the break. Samuels to face. Here we go.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

The Windies were going nowhere but then Blackwood played well by counterattacking and Samuels played the second fiddle. He got to his fifty in a jiffy but his partner took all the time in the world to get some runs under his belt. Just when it looked like West Indies will level the session, Ashwin took the prized wicket of Blackwood in the last over before Lunch. The second session promises to offer some more excitement where the ball is turning and providing assistance to the bowlers. Can West Indies answer better with the bat? Do join us in a bit to find out.

26 overs, 88 runs and 4 wickets. The first session had it all as far as a Test match is concerned. India started off superbly by reducing the hosts to 7/3. Ishant Sharma literally tore apart the top order by picking up 2 wickets and made the Windies toil for runs. Shami took one wicket in support.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Pushes this with soft hands towards mid on.
Full and on middle, Chase swings hard and gets it from the toe end of the bat towards mid on.
ROSTON CHASE walks in at number 6 to face 3 balls before Lunch.

OUT! LBW! Ashwin has his man! Flighted outside off, Blackwood comes half forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. There is a big appeal and umpire Aleem Dar raises his finger. Sir Viv Richards on air is not too happy with the decision, reckons that there is too much spin. Sanjay Manjrekar begs to differ though. Let us see what the Hawk Eye shows. Excellent knock from Blackwood, a run-a-ball 62 in a stand of 81. West Indies in a slightly better position. Hawk Eye shows that indeed to be spinning a long way, just clipping the leg stump. Way to go, Sir Viv!
Landed outside off again, Blackwood lunges to block.
Full and outside off, well defended.
A short ball around off, Samuels mistimes his pull to mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Floated around off, Marlon looks to defend and does so. Saha and Mishra appeal ferociously but then Mishra apologizes. Replays clearly show the ball hitting the bat. Ian Gould is getting angry with the continuous appealing here. Good that he was not umpiring the SL-Aus Test earlier on today.
On middle and leg, defended to the leg side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tossed up outside off, Samuels pushes to defend but is beaten by the away turn.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Another one spins in, Samuels looks to defend but gets an elbow and an inside edge and the ball lands just short of short leg.
Lands this outside off, Samuels looks to defend but gets an inside onto his pads which goes wide of short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, well defended.
Full on middle and leg, Samuels goes back to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. There is an LBW appeal but it is turned down.
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN gets back on.

HUGE, HUGE APPEAL FOR CAUGHT BEHIND! NOT OUT! Drama. Mishra is furious and frustrated, Kohli, as usual, is up and appealing confidently but strangely, Saha isn't that keen. He joins in late but umpire Ian Gould is unmoved. Replays do not seem to detect any outside edge.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a couple. The stand moves to 80 from 106 balls.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The googly outside off, Blackwood pushes to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.  A frustrated appeal from Mishra for LBW, turned down.
SIX! Smoked! Tremendous power. Tossed up outside off, spinning away, Blackwood gets down and slogs it straight back over the bowler's head and clears the fence with ease!
Full and outside off, well defended.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Another short ball on middle and off, defended to the leg side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

SIX! Cute shot! Short and wide outside off, Samuels gets under it and upper cuts it over backward point. In limited overs cricket, that might have been out but in Tests, you rarely see a third man. The ball lands beyond the ropes.
A bouncer around off, Samuels ducks. That is the 6th short ball in a row to Samuels from Yadav.
Landed around off, shorter in length, defended towards covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
It is drizzling and there is bright sunshine as well. Looks like a pair of jackals is getting married somewhere.
Beautifully tossed up outside off, Jermaine looks to defend but misses.
NO BALL. Sunil Gavaskar would have been angry had he been on air. How can a spinner bowl a no ball? However, Mishra oversteps and bowls it outside off, well defended.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
7th Test Fifty for Blackwood! His counter-attack has worked for him so far.

SIX! Stupendous! Full and outside off, Blackwood gets under it and smashes it straight back over the bowler for a biggie! Raises his bat to the crowd, a good innings thus far. Can he go on and get a big one?
Full and outside off, driven towards short extra cover.
A short ball down the leg side, shouldered arms to.
WIDE. Short and outside off, too high, Samuels ducks. Umpire Aleem Dar does not like the height of that ball and signals a wide.
Hits the deck hard, on a good length outside off, Samuels pushes at it but the ball bounces and hits the splice of the bat. Samuels' bottom hand comes off the bat. The ball goes to cover.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Around off, well defended.
Predictable stuff. Short around off, Jermaine pulls it to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Slaughtered! That is not the first time he has gone after the bowling. Full and outside off, Blackwood blasts it down the ground beating mid off. Replays show that it actually came of the toe end of the bat!
What a ball. Another googly outside off, well flighted, Samuels goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge which lands in front of silly point. Excellent over.
Outside off, slightly short, punched towards silly point.
Short leg moves to silly point now.
Around off, MS defends it down pretty late.
This is the googly outside off, Marlon reads it well and plays it towards covers at the last moment.
That is a beauty. Tossed up around off, Samuels lunges to defend but the ball spins past the outside edge.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point.
Another back foot defense.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Plays at that with soft hands and gets an outside edge which goes past gully to third man. Two runs taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
50-stand is up! In just 74 balls. Looks like a ODI game for the home side.

Full and around off, Blackwood looks to play straight but the ball comes in, takes the inner half of the bat and goes through the vacant mid-wicket region. Two runs taken. Good counter-attack from this pair.
Goes back to flick but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
A good delivery to end the over. Floated around middle, Marlon pushes forward and gets a bit of an outside edge which goes along the ground to Rahane at first slip.
A long hop again, outside off, 81 kph, Samuels goes back and punches it in front of point for a couple.
Short on middle, JB goes back and tucks it wide of mid on for a single.
More flight on this one, driven straight to cover.
A bit slower this time, around middle and leg, Jermaine pushes forward and gets it off to point.
Starts well, tosses this one outside off, Blackwood lunges to defend and gets a thick outside edge which does not carry to Ajinkya Rahane at first slip.
AMIT MISHRA gets a look-in now.
On middle, driven past the bowler towards mid on.

FOUR! Lazy elegance. That was uppish but in the gap. Full and outside off, Samuels leans into it without moving his feet much and drives it aerially, wide of short cover for a boundary. 50 UP FOR WEST INDIES!
Outside off, left alone.
Very full on middle, almost a yorker, pushed towards mid on.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
Landed outside off, defended from the crease.

Landed outside off, this one goes on with the arm, JB lunges to defend but misses.

However, Blackwood adjusts well, watches the ball carefully, gets to the pitch of the cherry and swings it miles over mid-wicket. Moves to 34 from 31 balls. His second biggie.

Another bouncer on middle, it is left alone.
Short ball on middle and leg, Samules ducks in and lets it through.
A good length ball outside off, left alone.
Full ball on off, defended watchfully.
Some confusion there. Full ball on off, Marlon taps it to point and looks to get off the mark. He is sent back just in time as Rahane made a good throw at the striker's end. No damage done.
Tad short outside off, Samuels off his front foot leaves it yet again. He is still on zero.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Finally gets one away. A length ball down the leg side, Blackwood tucks it fine and beats Shami at fine leg. The ball went very, very fine.
Looks to work this to the leg side but the ball goes off his pads to backward square leg.
Landed outside off, another slash and a miss. Blackwood seems to have come out with an idea of hitting out to get out of trouble.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
This one comes back in from outside off with the angle, Blackwood misses his tuck and is hit on the thigh pad.
NO BALL. Ishant oversteps and bowls a length ball outside off, Blackwood has a slash but misses. Doubt whether he heard the no ball call.
Tad full ball on off, Samuels reads the length properly and defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Length ball outside off, Marlon feels for it but leaves it at the end.
A good length ball wide outside off, Samuels doesn't bother and lets it through.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Edged and runs! Short ball on off, Blackwood goes for a pull and the ball goes off the top edge over the keeper. Welcome boundary.
Hurls a length ball on off, Blackwood looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge to gully on once bounce.
A play and a miss. Full ball on off, Samuels tries to loft but gets beaten.
Fuller ball on the pads, Samuels gets struck on the thigh pad.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A good length ball outside off, Marlon flicks it to the leg side, it goes off the inside edge via pads and falls just wide of Ashwin at short mid-wicket.
Tad fuller outside off, Samuels sees it and lets it through.
Hurls a length ball outside off, Blackwood leaves it for the keeper.
FOUR! Full ball wide outside off, Blackwood lofts it over covers for a boundary. Risky shot so early in the innings.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Peach! Length ball on middle, Blackwood leaves it but that ball almost hit the stumps as it went just over the middle and leg sticks. Lucky to survive there.
A full ball on off, defended off the front foot.
JERMAINE BLACKWOOD to bat next.

OUT! Shami strikes this time! A good length ball outside off, it moves away after pitching. Chandrika looks to fend at it. The ball catches a faint edge and it flies to the slip cordon. KL Rahul at wide third slip takes an easy catch. West Indies are falling like nine pins now.
Hurls a length ball on off, Samuels sees it early and lets it through.
Another ball down the leg side, is Ishant bowling to a left-hander? Samuels leaves that.
Wayward length outside off, left alone by Samuels.
No ball! Tad full  and down the leg side, Marlon looks to run that down but misses. No ball given for overstepping.
Another fuller ball on off, this time Marlon defends it watchfully.
Full ball on off, awkwardly defended by Samuels.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Marlon looks to flicks but it goes off the thigh pad to Rahul at short backward leg, there is an appeal for a catch but it is turned down.
Good leave! A perfect length outside off, angling in. The opener sights it early and leaves it for the keeper.
Short ball outside off, Chandrika looks to pull but withdraws at the last minute.
Fuller ball on the pads, Chandrika works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
A tad full ball on off, it held its line, Rajindra lets it through to the keeper.
Short ball on off, Chandrika fends it to the leg side.
The sightscreen issue continues...
A good length ball on off, Chandrika plays it to the off side with the full face of the bat.
Hat-trick ball! Bowls it full on off, Samuels looks to defend but it hits him high on the thigh pad. Eventful over.
MARLON SAMUELS is the new man in, replacing Bravo.

OUT! Two in two for Ishant! Length ball on off from around the wicket, it angles away a bit from the batsman. Bravo looks to defend that but it catches the nick and Kohli at second slip takes a superb low catch. Ishant Sharma is on fire. West Indies two down!
DARREN BRAVO is the next man in.

OUT! Ishant draws first blood! Hurls a length ball on middle and leg, Brathwaite looks to fend that. The bounce gets to him and it goes straight into the hands of the short leg fielder, Pujara. The aggressive fielding and the attacking mode has worked for team India. First wicket down for the hosts.
Full ball on the pads, Chandrika plays a flick shot. It goes just past the short leg fielder. Single taken.
A good length ball on off, it angles in after pitching. The opener leaves it for the keeper.
A good length ball outside off, Chandrika lets it through.
A good length ball on off, defended watchfully.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. They pick up a single.
Full ball on off, played straight down the ground.
Hurls a length ball outside off, left alone.
Full ball on off, played to the off side.

Straightway some action from Shami! Short ball on leg, Chandrika looks to pull that but it goes off his gloves. The ball bounces just short of Saha. The umpires check for the bounce and they decide it is not out. Good call by them.
MOHAMMED SHAMI will bowl from the other end.
A good length ball on middle and leg, Chandrika moves on the off side and flicks it to fine leg off his pads for a single. End of the first over.
Good length ball outside off, Chandrika sees it thud into the gloves of the keeper.
Off the mark West Indies! Full ball on off, Brathwaite shuffles across and plays it wide of short leg for a single. Good technique there by the opener.
Perfect length ball on middle and off, Brathwaite moves across and chips it to short leg.
Hurls a length ball on off, it angles in after pitching. Brathwaite defends it to the leg side awkwardly.
There is a delay because of some issues near sightscreen.
Length ball from wide outside of the crease, Brathwaite lets it through.

The players and the umpires are out there in the middle. Kraigg Brathwaite and Rajindra Chandrika are the two concerned openers for the hosts. Ishant Sharma will begin with the bowling proceedings. Here we go...

Virat Kohli, Indian captain - He says that it is not a bad toss to lose as the pitch looks damp and will help out their bowlers to put West Indies on the back foot. He states that they will look to win all the matches and seeing the record on this ground, result is on the card. (On the records) - He says that it is all about playing well and executing it here by scoring runs. Ends by confirming that they have one forced change as KL Rahul comes in for Murali Vijay who has a bruised thumb.

Jason Holder, West Indies captain - He says that they will bat first as the pitch has some moisture. (On the last match loss) - He says that they are recovering and have practiced well in the last two days. He also admits that they have had a good session in the nets and will look to do well in the game. (On the team changes) - He states that there is only one change in the team, Miguel Cummins makes his Test debut, replacing Carlos Brathwaite. (On the extra bowler) - He says that they will play the same combination.
TOSS - West Indies win the toss and elect to bat first.

Pitch Report - It seems there is a bit of grass on the surface. The pitch looks a belter as it will allow runs to flow. Spin will play an important role later in the match. Toss will play a valid point here.

From West Indian point of view, they will look to bat and bowl more accurately and solve their last match issues to level the 4-Test match series 1-1.  The pitch will favour the batters and winning the toss will play a key role. Do join us for the latest updates.

Hello and a warm welcome for 2nd Test between India and West Indies  at Sabina Park, Kingston. The visiting side is riding high after its last match victory. It was a perfect start for the Indian team with Kohli getting to his maiden double ton, Ashwin chipping in with a hundred and an elusive 7-fer. Others also played a good role with Shami, Umesh and Dhawan adding value to the side. It will be a positive start for team India after a comprehensive win at Antigua.
